title: Who played what in Tillman's band: Newton, Mudhouse, Edward
summary: Tillman on clarinet, Russ on drums, Willie Newton on bass, Gordak on trumpet, older Joe Mudhouse, and Edward briefly on trombone.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And Tillman was playing clarinet then? Correct. And you were playing drums? I was playing drums. Where did Willie Newton play? The bass of all of them. Well, who is Liberty Newton?
Liberty Newton. Did you ever hear of him?
No.
I don't know who else. I don't know, that's the only one I know is Willie Newton. Yeah, well. I never heard of another Willie Newton at all.
Somebody might have gotten the name mixed up too. Probably so, yeah. But you knew him well, so you know him.
Oh, we played together a long time.
And who was playing trumpet in the band? Gordak.
Gordak, yeah, yeah.
And, what was the guy's name, Mud, uh? Mudhouse was playing bandit.
He was a much older man than us. Mudhouse. Yeah, he called him Joe Mudhouse.
Yeah, that wasn't his right name?

Well, his name was Joe now. Yeah. But I'm not thinking, I'm thinking this is Joe. Joe's about thinking still, man. He's got a son living today. Oh. But he was, oh, he was, he was in my dad's class. He played around my dad that time. He was one of the one that picked us up, you know, and get a little, a few jobs, and we go on with him, we get jobs, and we check him with us, I think.
You know how old your daddy was when you were born?
How old he was? Yeah. Well, my daddy was 72 when he died. And what year did he die? The 51. 51. So, yeah, he was, Joe Mudhouse was way ahead of you.
He was here 20 years at the back. Oh, yeah. Much.
Yeah. Much 20 years now.
We see, we got drums, and we got bass and trumpet, and you played trombone? A saxophone?
That was Chairman's brother. Oh, yeah. He started to play in trombone. But he didn't, he didn't, he didn't stay with us, you know.
What was that, Eddie? Edward.
Edward, yeah. He didn't play, oh, he didn't play. I don't think he played six or eight months. Then he cut out of me. But he got in bed coming, and he cut out.
Well, he never did look healthy, didn't he?

Hmm? He never did look too healthy. Well, he was a young man at that time. Yeah. Now, me and Edward was back the same age, you know. Edward might be a year old with me, or maybe I might be the same age. But Tim was two years old, three years old at me. Hmm. Well, where did you play with this band? All over the city. Used to play all over. Used to feature, used to feature me at all times.
